@__export('con_neb_key_tst01')
def transfer(amount: float, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert __balances[ctx.caller] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send!'
    assert isinstance(amount, int), 'Amount must be an Integer!'
    __balances[ctx.caller] -= amount
    __balances[to] += amount


@__export('con_neb_key_tst01')
def approve(amount: float, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    __balances[ctx.caller, to] += amount


@__export('con_neb_key_tst01')
def transfer_from(amount: float, to: str, main_account: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert __balances[main_account, ctx.caller
        ] >= amount, 'Not enough coins approved to send! You have {} and are trying to spend {}'.format(
        __balances[main_account, ctx.caller], amount)
    assert __balances[main_account] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send!'
    assert isinstance(amount, int), 'Amount must be an Integer!'
    __balances[main_account, ctx.caller] -= amount
    __balances[main_account] -= amount
    __balances[to] += amount


@__export('con_neb_key_tst01')
def stake():
    assert __active.get() == True, 'Contract inactive!'
    assert __staking[ctx.caller] == None, 'Address is already staking!'
    assert now > __stake_start_date.get(), 'Staking not started yet!'
    assert now < __stake_start_date.get() + datetime.timedelta(minutes=
        __stake_period.get()), 'Staking period ended!'
    neb.transfer_from(amount=__stake_amount.get(), to=ctx.this,
        main_account=ctx.caller)
    __staking[ctx.caller] = now


@__export('con_neb_key_tst01')
def unstake():
    assert __active.get() == True, 'Contract inactive!'
    assert __staking[ctx.caller] != None, 'Address is not staking!'
    total_stake_time = __stake_start_period.get() + __stake_period.get()
    if now < __stake_start_date.get() + datetime.timedelta(minutes=
        total_stake_time):
        tax = int(__stake_amount.get() / 100 * __stake_tax.get())
        payout = __stake_amount.get() - tax
        neb.transfer(amount=payout, to=ctx.caller)
        __vault = ForeignVariable(foreign_contract='con_nebula',
            foreign_name='vault_contract', contract='con_neb_key_tst01',
            name='vault')
        if not __vault.get():
            __vault = Variable(contract='con_neb_key_tst01', name='vault')
            __vault.set('INTERNAL_NEB_VAULT')
        neb.transfer(amount=tax, to=__vault.get())
        __staking[ctx.caller] = None
        return 'Unstaked early. No KEY token minted. Payed back {} NEB'.format(
            int(payout))
    else:
        neb.transfer(amount=__stake_amount.get(), to=ctx.caller)
        __balances[ctx.caller] += 1
        __total_supply.set(__total_supply.get() + 1)
        __staking[ctx.caller] = None
        return 'Unstaked and minted 1 KEY token. Payed back {} NEB'.format(int
            (__stake_amount.get()))
